name: holotape
description: Holotape: write to Jira so it renders and reads well, through either of the two common Jira MCPs. Works out whether the session has Atlassian's own MCP (the claude.ai connector: Markdown or HTML stored as ADF, comment editing, real mentions, status lozenges and smart-link cards) or mcp-atlassian (wiki markup, a Markdown converter that breaks things) and applies that server's format rules, with a catalogue of every Jira element, comment and description templates for both, comments shaped for their news, a linter that previews what mcp-atlassian will send, and the read-first / confirm / verify steps around posting.
